placementFindings.mappedLegacySourceMatch: All 261 legacy non-synth packed highway=traffic_signals points match fresh OSM highway=traffic_signals within 1 metre. They were not absent, but provenance was missing.
placementFindings.exportGuessSourceGap: All 94 explicitly synthesized packed signals lack a current mapped signal node within 30m. This is absence of support, not photo proof of physical absence.
placementFindings.runtimeGuessSourceGap: 1,148 logical runtime-inferred sites add signals on topology alone. A busy junction is insufficient evidence of actual traffic-light equipment.
placementFindings.elevatedReviewPolicy: Each has only bridge/layer-positive incident source road ways. Preserve evidence; require matching native road grade or leave inactive for review. Never bind these points to nearest ground road.

coverageLimits: 269 OSM nodes are a source snapshot, not complete inventory of all real signals across Hyderabad. A junction can contain multiple mapped heads or crossings.
A recently retrieved OSM record may have old underlying edits. Edit timestamp is not a survey/inspection date.
No current authoritative full-coordinate junction inventory or per-junction phase/timing dataset was found in the bounded primary-source review. No live state or countdown is verified.
Fresh OSM gives source-way membership and tangent, not exact pole/facing/stop-line coordinates. Rendered approach positions and game phase cycles must stay explicitly simulated.
recommendedIntegration: Use a separate source-backed signal importer against existing compressed packs/core; do not rerun full legacy city export.
Replace only signal records. Remove packed synth and runtime topology-generated signals; retain all non-signal furniture, shopfronts, buildings, roads, landmarks, source evidence and map geometry.
Preserve source node IDs, source URLs, version/timestamp, retrieval time, original tags, incident way IDs and source-way-forward normalized headings in the exact core east/south projection.
Filter private/no access points and source ways; retain public crossing signal distinctions and button-operated tags. Do not turn pedestrian-only footway heads into vehicle control.
Use same-grade road association and source direction; unresolved grade/direction or remote geometry stays reviewable. Exact source ways and XY must not be overwritten by inferred junction names.
Serialize imports with the shopfront apply lock, use atomic gzip pack/core replacement and refresh compressed manifest bytes. Verify idempotence and unchanged unrelated asset hashes/counts.

unsupportedSignalRoadReview.method: Current OSM source-node nearest XY comparison; shipped road local interpolated height at nearest segment within20m; top20 nearby roads considered. This is a review list, not independent photo confirmation of signal absence or flyover control.
